svg.title: Longer cable slows a high-impedance passive signal
svg.desc: A 100 kilo-ohm source resistance drives a high-input-resistance receiver with cable capacitance lumped from signal to return. Assumed capacitance is 100 picofarads per metre. Computed 2 metre and 20 metre step responses have time constants 20 and 200 microseconds. Solid and dashed curves reach 90 percent at 46.05 and 460.52 microseconds. The plot is a passive settling model, not a noise, transmission-line, or active-driver stability simulation.
